stages.title: First Session
stages.details:
Inaugural Meeting The Constituent Assembly met for the first time in New Delhi.

Objective Resolution Introduced by Jawaharlal Nehru on Dec 13, laying the philosophical fundamentals.

stages.title: Second Session
stages.details: Resolution Adopted The Assembly unanimously adopted the Objective Resolution on January 22, 1947.

stages.title: Third Session
stages.details: Princely States Join Representatives from the Princely States took their seats in the Assembly.

stages.title: Fourth Session
stages.details: National Flag On July 22, 1947, the Assembly adopted the Free India National Flag.

stages.title: Fifth Session
stages.details:
Midnight Session The Assembly met at midnight on August 14 to assume power for independent India.

Drafting Committee Appointed on August 29, 1947, with Dr. B.R. Ambedkar as its Chairman.

stages.title: Sixth Session
stages.details: Short Session A brief session held to discuss minor procedural matters.

stages.title: Seventh Session
stages.details: First Reading Dr. B.R. Ambedkar introduced the final Draft Constitution and delivered a brilliant speech defending its provisions.

stages.title: Eighth Session
stages.details: Debates Continue Intensive clause-by-clause debates continued, focusing heavily on Fundamental Rights and Directive Principles.

stages.title: Ninth Session
stages.details: Crucial Debates The Assembly saw fierce debates regarding the Official Language and Citizenship.

stages.title: Tenth Session
stages.details: Second Reading Completed The second reading of the Constitution, the most rigorous part of the drafting process, was finally concluded.

stages.title: Eleventh Session
stages.details:
Third Reading Final revisions and the third reading of the draft.

Adoption Day On November 26, 1949, the Constitution was officially adopted, enacted, and given to the people of India.

stages.title: Final Meeting
stages.details:
Signatures The Assembly met once again on 24 January, 1950, when the members appended their signatures to the Constitution of India.

National Anthem & Song 'Jana Gana Mana' and 'Vande Mataram' adopted.
